first_frame_visual: Minimalist white background. On the left, a stickman wearing red/gold nanotech housing pod. On the right, a stickman wearing black suit with purple glowing tribal patterns. Text overlays: NANOTECH vs VIBRANIUM.

script_lines.text: This is a Nanotech suit. This is a Vibranium suit.
Most people think both are just super-strong armors. They're not.
Nanotech reshapes micro-bots instantly into weapons or shields, but permanently loses total mass whenever damaged.
Vibranium traps incoming kinetic energy inside its atomic weave, storing physical force until releasing a massive shockwave.
Nanotech burns mass to construct offense, while Vibranium absorbs hit energy to burst power.
Next is Uru Metal vs Adamantium. Follow so you don't miss it.
